{{Top|leg}}
A '''proton core''' was a component of a [[Proton grenade/Legends|proton grenade]]. It was a smaller version of the [[Proton-scattering energy warhead|warhead]] used in [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedoes]].<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
